newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli warplanes rocket south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli warplanes rocket south Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli warplanes rocketed suspected pro-Iranian Hizbollah targets in south Lebanon on Monday, Lebanese security sources said.
There was no immediate report of casualties in the air assault -- the 47th into Lebanon since the beginning of the year.

The sources said two warplanes fired four rockets into the area of Ain Qana in the Iqlim al-Toufah mountain ridges -- a pro-Hizbollah stronghold used for attacks on Israeli forces and their militia allies.
The raid came hours after Hizbollah guerrillas fired rocket-propelled grenades and machineguns at a pro-Israeli outpost in Jizzine.

Pro-Israeli South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia sources said no one was injured in the attack. Jizzine is a strip of land officially outside Israel's 15 km (nine miles)-wide south Lebanon occupation zone but under SLA control.
On Sunday, an SLA militiaman was seriously wounded by a Hizbollah missile fired at his outpost in Braachit inside the zone, according to Israeli security sources.
A 15-year-old Lebanese girl had been wounded hours earlier when Hizbollah shelled the outpost of Rihan inside the zone, according to SLA sources.
On Saturday, Hizbollah said its fighters fired Katyusha rockets into an Israeli outpost in south Lebanon after an Israeli shell wounded a Lebanese woman north of the area.
Lebanon has said it would complain about the civilian injury to a five-nation committee monitoring an April 1996 ceasefire understanding which ended a 17-day Israeli blitz on Lebanon.

Under the terms of the ceasefire, Israeli forces and Lebanese guerrillas are banned from hitting civilian targets on both sides of the border. The deal does not prohibit Hizbollah from fighting Israeli troops and their local militia allies.
Hizbollah guerrillas are fighting to oust Israeli troops and their militia allies from the occupation zone.
Hizbollah this month threatened to resume rocket attacks on northern Israel if Lebanese civilians fell victim again to Israeli attacks.
